text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Friday it had removed Creditanstalt Bankverein from RatingWatch with postive implications and raised its long-term rating to AA minus from A plus.
It also raised its short-term rating to A1 plus from A1.
"The rating action follows approval by the European Commission of Bank Austria's takeover of the bank," IBCA said in a statement.

As part of the terms of agreement between Bank Austria and the Austrian government, Creditanstalt must remain an independent entity for a minimum of five years and does not benefit from the deficiency guarantee of the city of Vienna that applies to Bank Austria, IBCA said.
"However, the change in Creditanstalt's ratings reflects its new status as a subsidiary of Bank Austria and its position as part of the dominant banking group within Austria," it said.
